description: ClickHouse monitoring: workload, per-database load, users, node/tables. Prometheus-only. Select the target Prometheus when importing this dashboard. Database read load is approximate.

panels.title: Database write load (bytes/s)
panels.description: Compressed bytes written per database over the workload window. Respects the user filter.

panels.title: Database read load (approx, bytes/s)
panels.description: Approximate: read_bytes of every query touching the database is counted in each database it reads.

panels.title: Active queries by database
panels.description: Current system.processes grouped by current_database. Respects the user filter.

panels.title: Active memory by database
panels.description: Current memory of running queries grouped by current_database.

panels.title: Who is active now, by database
panels.description: Current running queries per user and database.

panels.title: Database read queries (approx)
panels.description: Number of queries touching each database; a query reading several databases counts in each.

panels.title: Oldest running query by database
panels.description: Elapsed time of the oldest running query in the database.

title: ClickHouse / Overview
